sqlquery.from:
(select distinct tk.name as taskname, tk.startdate, tk.duedate, tk.estimatedtime, CAST(to_char(coalesce(tk.percent,0),'990.99') AS real) percent, st.name as taskstatus, pj.name as projectname, cl.name as clientname, coalesce(ts.timespent, 0) as timespent, coalesce(ats.approvettimespent, 0) as approvettimespent, coalesce(bts.billtimespent, 0) as billtimespent, coalesce(ats.approvettimespent, 0) - coalesce(bts.billtimespent, 0) as nonbilltimespent from "$".task tk LEFT JOIN "$"."reference" st on st.id= tk.statusid LEFT JOIN "$".project pj on tk.projectid = pj.id LEFT JOIN "$".crmaccount cl ON pj.clientid = cl.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT sum(timespent) timespent, taskid from "$".timesheet group by taskid ) ts on tk.id = ts.taskid LEFT JOIN ( SELECT sum(timespent) approvettimespent, taskid from "$".timesheet INNER JOIN "$".reference ref on statusid=ref.id where ref.code='_APPROVE' group by taskid ) ats on tk.id = ats.taskid LEFT JOIN ( SELECT sum(timespent) billtimespent, taskid from "$".timesheet where usedininvoice=true group by taskid ) bts on tk.id = bts.taskid
WHERE pj.isdeleted!=true AND tk.deleted!=true AND (tk.isissue is null OR tk.isissue!=true)) t
